finding location=drivers/tty/synclink_gt.c:1151-1160 confidence=high conclusion=synclink_gt.c compat ioctl set_params32 holds info->lock with plain spin_lock (1159) while hardirq slgt_interrupt (request_irq:3638) takes the same ISR-shared lock plainly (2362/2381) - same-CPU IRQ preemption spins forever; high-confidence interrupt-context DoS.
unresolved location=sound/pci/ens1370.c:2349 conclusion=Follow up: identify the functions around ens1370.c 814/840/1001-1035/2153/2165 and confirm any runs in process context with IRQs enabled - a plain holder against the plain ISR taker at 2349 is a reportable hardirq lockup.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/gadget/udc/mv_udc_core.c:2007 conclusion=Follow up: classify each plain spin_lock(&udc->lock) site in mv_udc_core.c by caller context; a process-context plain holder against the hardirq taker at 2007 confirms the defect.
unresolved location=drivers/staging/emxx_udc/emxx_udc.c:2358 conclusion=Follow up: trace emxx_udc.c plain udc->lock sites 124/1664/1853/2241/2301/2321 to their callers; any process-context plain holder against the hardirq takers at 2334/2358 is reportable.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/gadget/udc/lpc32xx_udc.c:2740 conclusion=Follow up: trace lpc32xx_udc.c plain spin_lock(&udc->lock) sites 1432/1551/2287/2936/2949; a process-context plain holder against the plain hardirq takers at 2740/2779/2821 confirms the defect.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/isp1760/isp1760-udc.c:1276 conclusion=Follow up: classify isp1760-udc.c plain udc->lock sites 284/325/513/548/592/651 by caller context against the plain hardirq takers at 1276/1315.
unresolved location=drivers/net/wan/sbni.c:509 conclusion=Follow up: trace sbni.c plain nl->lock sites 1185/1223/1328/1392/1424 to their functions; any process-context plain holder against the ISR taker at 509 is reportable.
unresolved location=drivers/tty/serial/zs.c:722 conclusion=Follow up: classify each zs.c plain zlock site 382-693 by caller; a process-context plain holder against the ISR taker at 722 would confirm the defect.
unresolved location=sound/parisc/harmony.c:300 conclusion=Follow up: read harmony.c around 300/336 and their callers; a process-context plain acquisition of h->lock against the plain ISR takers is a reportable defect.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/renesas/ravb_main.c:807 conclusion=Follow up: map ravb_main.c interrupt dispatch and check whether any non-hardirq path (NAPI poll, ethtool, open/close) takes priv->lock plainly against the taker at 807.
unresolved location=sound/pci/korg1212/korg1212.c:1109 conclusion=Follow up: identify the enclosing function of korg1212.c line 1585 and its callers; a process-context plain acquisition against the hardirq takers at 1109/1169/1175 is reportable.
unresolved location=drivers/net/ethernet/dec/tulip/winbond-840.c:1292 conclusion=Follow up: trace winbond-840.c line 1292 to its function and callers; a process-context plain holder of np->lock against the hardirq taker at 1141 confirms the defect.
coverage_gap=Handler definition resolution found in-file bodies for 2082 of 2333 unique non-NULL handler names; the remaining 246 (macro-declared or defined in another file) were never checked for lock usage.
coverage_gap=Cross-indexing matched lock expressions only textually within the registering file, so locks shared across files via exported helpers or spelled differently (&priv->lock vs &dev->lock aliases) could be missed.
coverage_gap=request_threaded_irq sites were parsed for the primary handler only; acquisitions of handler-shared locks from the thread_fn (process context) were not separately audited.
coverage_gap=Only hardirq-side plain/irq acquisitions were cross-indexed; files where the handler uses irqsave but a process path still uses plain spin_lock against a different same-file IRQ context (e.g. chained irq handlers via irq_chip) were not enumerated.
